en.t: Toward evening, General Kaoru came to visit.
Prince Niou said, “Please come inside and sit down.”

units.source_text: 薰大将言道：“听说你身体不适，皇后很担心呢。

en.t: General Kaoru said, “I heard that you have been unwell, and the Empress is very worried about you.
Are you feeling any better now?”

units.source_text: 匂亲王一见薰大将，便觉胸中扑通扑通地跳，话也不能多说。

en.t: As soon as Prince Niou saw General Kaoru, his heart began pounding, and he could hardly say much.

units.source_text: 他想：“此人本来像个得道和尚，然而道行未免太高深了：

en.t: He thought, “This man has always seemed like an enlightened monk, but his spiritual discipline is a little too profound:

units.source_text: 把那样可爱的人儿藏在山里，让她望穿秋水，而自己满不在乎。”

en.t: he hides such a lovely person away in the mountains, leaves her waiting in longing, and remains perfectly unconcerned himself.”

units.source_text: 倘在平时，即使逢到些些小事，他看见薰大将装作诚实人或自称诚实人时，

en.t: At ordinary times, even over the smallest matter, whenever he saw General Kaoru acting sincere or calling himself sincere,

units.source_text: 必然极口讥笑他，说破他；

en.t: he would certainly mock him mercilessly and expose him;

units.source_text: 如果发见了他在山中藏着女人，不知道将何等肆意地挖苦他呢。

en.t: if he had discovered that Kaoru was hiding a woman in the mountains, who knows how freely he would have ridiculed him.

units.source_text: 然而今天他一句戏言也不说，脸上只是显出非常痛苦的神色。

en.t: Yet today he did not make a single joke, and his face showed only an expression of great distress.

units.source_text: 薰大将蒙在鼓里，说道：“我看你的样子很不舒服呢。

en.t: General Kaoru, knowing nothing of this, said, “You look very unwell to me.

units.source_text: 虽然不是重病，但日子拖久了很不好。

en.t: Even if it is not a serious illness, it is very bad for it to drag on.

units.source_text: 必须多多保重，当心受风。”

en.t: You must take very good care of yourself and be careful not to catch a chill.”

units.source_text: 他诚恳地慰问了一番，就告辞而去。

en.t: After offering his sincere words of concern, he took his leave and went away.

units.source_text: 匂亲王独自寻思：“此人风度翩翩，令人看了自觉羞惭。

en.t: Prince Niou reflected to himself, “This man is so graceful and elegant that merely seeing him makes one feel ashamed.

units.source_text: 山中那个女子把我和他相比，不知作何感想？”

en.t: When that woman in the mountains compares me with him, I wonder what she thinks?”

units.source_text: 他想这样，想那样，时刻不忘地想念那山中女子。

en.t: Thinking of this and that, he kept remembering the woman in the mountains without forgetting her for a moment.
